title: SRS Container
description: A lightweight grouping boundary over a collection of instances. Containers answer scoping questions — which instances belong together — that the Relation graph alone cannot answer.

containerId.description: Stable UUID for this Container. Must not appear in Relation.sourceInstanceId or targetInstanceId.

name.description: Optional machine-readable name within the namespace.

description.description: Optional description of the Container's purpose.

containerType.description: Soft-deprecated hint (RFC-009). When rootInstanceIds is present, SHOULD equal the resolved root Type's name field (bare name, not namespace/name). A mismatch is diagnostic-only; the Container remains valid. See RFC-009 I-64.

rootInstanceIds.description: Top-level instances this Container was created to hold. Implementations may derive nested members by traversing contains Relations from these roots.

memberInstanceIds.description: Explicit membership list for all instances in scope. When present, allows membership queries without graph traversal.

identityInstanceId.description: RFC-013 / RFC-029. The instance id of the record that is this Container's identity / purpose statement. On the root container (manifest.container), names the repository's identity record. Reassignable; when present MUST equal a member id in rootInstanceIds or memberInstanceIds (RFC-013 I-81). RFC-029 additionally requires that on the root container (manifest.container), this MUST reference a Tier-2 Record of type com.semanticops.core/purpose (RFC-029 I-87); for non-root containers this type constraint does not apply. See RFC-013 I-81, RFC-029 R5.

anchorInstanceId.description: RFC-009 (amended by srs#446). The instance id of the record whose Type (typeId + typeVersion) is this Container's typing anchor — the type RFC-009 rootTypeRefs matching (I-63) and RFC-010 three-way-merge conflict detection resolve against. Declared, never positional (rfc-decision-cce3c00e, cell Containment: 'declaration over location'). When present, MUST equal a member id in rootInstanceIds or memberInstanceIds (I-145). When absent — a repository authored before srs#446 — implementations MUST fall back to treating rootInstanceIds[0] (the first entry) as the typing anchor; this positional fallback is transitional and is withdrawn at the Continuity flip (rfc-decision-cce3c00e axis 2-8, the first full public release), after which anchorInstanceId is required wherever a typing anchor is needed. rootInstanceIds/memberInstanceIds carry no other positional significance (RFC-013 [R5]).

tags.description: Vocabulary-backed topic labels (RFC-009 + RFC-006). When a Vocabulary in the package declares Terms for a tag key, tags MUST resolve per RFC-006 vocabulary resolution rules. Free-string tags are valid when no Vocabulary governs the key.

meta.description: Implementation-local metadata. Cross-system keys should be namespaced.
